mosques.name: Bait Ur Rouf Mosque
key_lessons: Square envelope with rotated cylindrical prayer volume resolving a 13-degree qibla/site mismatch
Porous brick and light courts support ventilation/daylight
Raised plinth responds to flooding and supports community life

mosques.name: Great Mosque of Niono
key_lessons: Load-bearing mud brick, arches, timber/matting/earth roof assemblies
Structural module tied to available timber length

mosques.name: Yaama Mosque
key_lessons: Incremental evolution from rectangular hypostyle hall
Later addition of central dome and corner towers

mosques.name: Saïd Naum Mosque
key_lessons: Modern mosque design rooted in Indonesian context

mosques.name: Mosque of the Grand National Assembly
key_lessons: Mosque form can depart from conventional dome/minaret vocabulary
Qibla wall can become a daylight/landscape interface

mosques.name: Chandgaon Mosque
key_lessons: Light and abstract form as primary spatial devices

mosques.name: Corniche Mosque
key_lessons: Traditional masonry techniques can be reinterpreted for contemporary projects

mosques.name: Bhong Mosque
key_lessons: Long-duration craft-led building involving specialists from Pakistan and India

mosques.name: Sherefudin's White Mosque
key_lessons: Abstract modern spatial language can remain legible as a community mosque

mosques.name: Al-Qaraouiyine Mosque Rehabilitation
key_lessons: Mosque, education and urban heritage can be treated as one institutional system
